content.json:
# Storm-3168 containment evidence
**Live results: NOT TESTED.** Select the exact lab workspace and resource-group/actor IDs, then set the UTC range for one recorded trial. Repeat for each independent trial; this workbook does not infer phase boundaries.

Provider logs measure visibility, not the fixed-credential probe outcome. Missing tables/rows, expiry and delivery latency are not successful containment. No harness JSONL is ingested, and no synthetic cloud tables are assumed. Raw IDs and IPs in query results are private evidence; redact before publication.

parameters.name: TrialLabel
parameters.value: NOT TESTED — select one recorded trial

content.query:
let LabResourceGroupId = "{LabResourceGroupId}";
let ActorObjectId = "{ActorObjectId}";
let LabGroup = tolower(trim_end(@"/+", LabResourceGroupId));
let LabPrefix = strcat(LabGroup, "/");
AzureActivity
| extend ResourceId = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("_ResourceId", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("ResourceId", "")))
| extend NormalizedResourceId=tolower(ResourceId)
| where NormalizedResourceId == LabGroup or NormalizedResourceId startswith LabPrefix
| extend ActorOid=tolower(coalesce(tostring(Claims_d["http://schemas.microsoft.com/identity/claims/objectidentifier"]),tostring(Claims_d.oid),Caller)),
    WorkspaceIngestionTime=ingestion_time()
| project TimeGenerated, EventSubmissionTimestamp, WorkspaceIngestionTime,
    ActorIsTestPrincipal=(ActorOid == tolower(ActorObjectId)), ActorObjectId=ActorOid,
    OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, ActivitySubstatusValue,
    ResourceId, EventDataId, OperationId, CorrelationId
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Control-plane timeline — selected trial window

content.query:
let LabResourceGroupId = "{LabResourceGroupId}";
let ActorObjectId = "{ActorObjectId}";
let LabGroup = tolower(trim_end(@"/+", LabResourceGroupId));
let LabPrefix = strcat(LabGroup, "/");
AzureActivity
| extend ResourceId = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("_ResourceId", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("ResourceId", "")))
| extend ActorOid = tolower(coalesce(
    tostring(Claims_d["http://schemas.microsoft.com/identity/claims/objectidentifier"]),
    tostring(Claims_d.oid), Caller))
| where ActorOid == tolower(ActorObjectId)
| extend NormalizedResourceId = tolower(ResourceId)
| where NormalizedResourceId == LabGroup or NormalizedResourceId startswith LabPrefix
| where tolower(ActivityStatusValue) in ("success","succeeded","failed","failure")
| where isnotempty(EventDataId)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EventDataId
| summarize Records=count(), UniqueOperations=dcount(OperationId)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Repeated actor operations — does not count independent trials

content.query:
let ActorObjectId="{ActorObjectId}";
let LabTenantId="{LabTenantId}";
AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
| where ServicePrincipalId =~ ActorObjectId and AADTenantId =~ LabTenantId
| extend WorkspaceIngestionTime=ingestion_time()
| project TimeGenerated, CreatedDateTime, WorkspaceIngestionTime, ServicePrincipalId,
    AppId, IPAddress, ResourceDisplayName, ClientCredentialType, ResultType,
    ResultSignature, ResultDescription, ConditionalAccessStatus, CorrelationId, Id
| order by CreatedDateTime asc
content.title: Authentication timeline — independent of per-request authorization

content.query:
let LabResourceGroupId = "{LabResourceGroupId}";
let ActorObjectId = "{ActorObjectId}";
let LabGroup = tolower(trim_end(@"/+", LabResourceGroupId));
let LabPrefix = strcat(LabGroup, "/");
AzureActivity
| extend ResourceId = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("_ResourceId", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("ResourceId", "")))
| extend ActorOid = tolower(coalesce(
    tostring(Claims_d["http://schemas.microsoft.com/identity/claims/objectidentifier"]),
    tostring(Claims_d.oid), Caller))
| where ActorOid == tolower(ActorObjectId)
| extend NormalizedResourceId = tolower(ResourceId)
| where NormalizedResourceId == LabGroup or NormalizedResourceId startswith LabPrefix
| extend WorkspaceIngestionTime=ingestion_time()
| extend ProviderDelaySeconds=datetime_diff("millisecond",EventSubmissionTimestamp,TimeGenerated)/1000.0,
    WorkspaceDelaySeconds=datetime_diff("millisecond",WorkspaceIngestionTime,TimeGenerated)/1000.0
| project TimeGenerated, EventSubmissionTimestamp, WorkspaceIngestionTime,
    ProviderDelaySeconds, WorkspaceDelaySeconds, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, EventDataId
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Event delivery delay — not access revocation time
